title: journal-record
description: One line of the per-repo turn journal (~/.config/slot/journal/<repo>.jsonl): an append-only fact about the fleet. The journal is history, never consumed (the inbox is the mailbox). The `type` vocabulary is closed per version: turn-* records are reserved for writers that hold the document's turn section; pane dispatch writes task-dispatched (fire-and-forget delivery has no observable completion, so it must never open a turn). v2 adds the supervision facts (pr-merged, surfaced, delivered, watch-degraded) and relaxes `slot` to optional - delivered/watch-degraded are fleet-scoped. Slot-scoped types still carry `slot` by writer contract (prose, not schema: the zero-dep validator has no conditionals). Validation is write-side only; reads stay tolerant, so v1 records remain readable.

ts.description: when the fact was recorded, epoch ms

slot.description: the slot label the fact is about (absent on fleet-scoped facts)

type.description: closed v2 vocabulary; extend by schema bump, never ad hoc

pr.description: pr-merged: the merged PR number (dedup key with slot)

claimTs.description: surfaced with reason crash: the claim ts in the dedup key - a re-claimed slot's crash must not collide with the old claim's fact

slots.description: delivered: the slots the digest covered
